title: Raas Garba Festival 2026 Sat, Oct 24th - 7:30 Pm
description: Dance to the Beat of Tradition at the BAYVP-ICA-CCF Raas Garba Festival 2026
long_description:
Dance to the Beat of Tradition at the BAYVP-ICA-CCF Raas Garba Festival 2026
Mark your calendars for the 24th of October, 2026 as the Bay Area Youth Vaishnav Parivar (shahsaumilb) proudly presents the BAYVP-ICA-CCF Raas Garba Festival in San Jose, CA. This much-anticipated event is a celebration of Gujarati culture and the Navratri/Dandiya festivities. Join us under the star-studded night as we dance, sing, and revel in the joyous spirit of the Raas Garba, a traditional Gujarati folk dance.
The Magic of Anonymous Artists
While the artist performing at the BAYVP-ICA-CCF Raas Garba Festival 2026 remains a surprise, rest assured that their talent will captivate and enthrall you. Our artist's unique style and interpretation of traditional Gujarati music promise an unforgettable night of joy and celebration. Come and witness the magic of their performance that will surely make the festival a night to remember.
Experience Tradition at Shreemaya Krishnadham Haveli
The BAYVP-ICA-CCF Raas Garba Festival 2026 will be held at the magnificent Shreemaya Krishnadham Haveli, located at 175 Nortech Parkway, San Jose, CA, United States. The venue is known for its serene and spiritual ambiance, perfectly echoing the spirit of the Gujarati culture. Safety and accessibility are key features of this location. As for your gastronomic needs, there are numerous Indian restaurants nearby to satisfy your cravings before or after the event. With ample parking space, you won't have to worry about where to leave your vehicle.
Secure Your Seats Today!
Don't miss the chance to be part of this cultural extravaganza. We offer tickets at reasonable prices: Adults can join the fun for just $25.00, while children aged 5 to 12 years can get tickets for $20.00. We also value our seniors, aged 70 years and above, who can enjoy the event for only $20.00. Secure your seats today and get ready for an unforgettable night of traditional Gujarati festivities!
